authorization_source: Explicit governed control message: Proceed authorized
objective: Verify that the protected GitHub OIDC target identity has effective permission to update the existing ServiceTracer demo API VM extension without mutating Azure.

source_binding.rule: Commit a separate one-shot execution marker only after exact-head pull-request CI succeeds for the reviewed verification package.

success_criteria: Exact-head pull-request CI succeeds for the reviewed package head.
Protected target OIDC login succeeds in the expected subscription and tenant.
ARM validation succeeds for the existing extension-only template.
What-If contains exactly one material Modify for the existing servicetracer-demo-api extension.
Resource inventory remains seven resources before and after.
Public API health remains HTTP-successful and healthy.
No Azure mutation, workload deployment, transaction replay, merge, publication, or cleanup occurs.
failure_behavior: Fail closed, upload available sanitized evidence, consume the one-shot grant, and preserve effective permission as unverified.
cost_implication: No recurring Azure resource is created. GitHub Actions execution and Azure control-plane requests may use ordinary platform capacity; no compute, disk, public IP, network, or quota-consuming resource change is authorized.
termination: The grant is consumed when the protected verification workflow attempts Azure verification, regardless of success or failure. Retry requires new explicit authorization.
claim_boundary: Verification authorized != deployment authorized. Successful verification does not renew the previously consumed deployment grant.
